# Three portal components import marked by a path that leaves the package

## Context

Measured 2026-09-18 in a consumer workspace (neomjs/neo-agent-institution, engine `dev@3f859a4803`): `npm run build-all` exits 1 —

```
ERROR in ./node_modules/neo.mjs/apps/portal/view/news/discussions/Component.mjs 2:0-84
Module not found: Error: Can't resolve '../../../../../node_modules/marked/lib/marked.esm.js'
```

and the same for `news/pulls/Component.mjs` and `news/tickets/Component.mjs`. `webpack 5.111.0 compiled with 3 errors`.

## The Problem

`#17868` and `#17997` moved the engine's `src/` off filesystem-path imports: `src/component/Markdown.mjs` and `src/app/content/Component.mjs` import `dist/marked.mjs`. Three portal components were left on the old form:

```
apps/portal/view/news/{discussions,pulls,tickets}/Component.mjs:2
import {marked} from '../../../../../node_modules/marked/lib/marked.esm.js';
```

That path resolves only while neo *is* the repository root. As a dependency it names `node_modules/neo.mjs/node_modules/marked`, where a flat npm install never puts anything — and a consumer still compiles these files, because the App worker's lazy webpack context spans `node_modules/neo.mjs/(apps|docs/app|examples|src)/**/app.mjs`.

## The Architectural Reality

- The engine's own build (`.github/workflows/build.yml`) cannot see it: at the repo root the path resolves.
- `check-consumer-runtime-build` builds a consumer fixture's Data worker and Main only, not the App worker whose context pulls the portal in.
- Consumers that bridged the old defect with a postinstall copy (the Institution's `linkMarkedForWorkerScope.mjs`) retire that bridge the moment `dist/marked.mjs` exists — which the first `build-all` creates. So the first build passes and every later one fails.

## The Fix

The three imports take the bundled artifact the way `src/` does: `'../../../../../dist/marked.mjs'` (same depth, repo root → `dist/`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No file under `apps/`, `examples/`, `docs/app/` or `src/` imports through a relative `node_modules/` path (`git grep` receipt in the PR).
- [ ] The portal's three news views still render markdown (the existing portal e2e/component coverage stays green).
- [ ] Post-merge, in a consumer at the pin that carries this: `build-all` compiles the App worker with 0 errors, twice in a row.

## Out of Scope

Extending `check-consumer-runtime-build` to the App worker (worth its own ticket: it is the guard that would have caught this). Whether `apps/portal` should ship inside the package at all.

## Avoided Traps

Re-adding a consumer-side copy of `marked` under `node_modules/neo.mjs/` — npm prunes it on the next install, which is how this surfaced.
